theme.primary_archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Light Mode Enterprise
theme.description: Gartner-grade enterprise SaaS, highly structural, functional, clean. High data density with authoritative trust signals.

typography.rules: Never center-align large blocks of text. Stick to left-aligned hierarchy. Avoid pure black text, use slate-900 or institution specific dark neutral.

color_palettes.global_rules: No pure white backgrounds for main content areas if panels are used. Prefer a 2-3% tinted off-white or light gray for app background, with pure white cards. 1px borders everywhere (border-collapse look).

sidebar.style: Solid border-r (border-border), crisp, flat background. No floating shadows.

topbar.style: Sticky z-40, bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border. Items aligned center with gap-4.

institution_switcher.ux: Located top-left next to logo or top-right. Uses Shadcn DropdownMenu or Select. Triggers global CSS class change on <html> (e.g., .isb-theme). Must swap logos, colors, and data context instantaneously.
institution_switcher.visual: Crisp icon-based trigger. Dropdown shows institution name + 'Enterprise Tenant' sub-label.

language_switcher_rtl.ux: Toggle EN / AR. When AR is selected, add dir='rtl' to HTML root. Sidebar flips to right, topbar items flip. Ensure Lucide icons use RTL flip where directional.
language_switcher_rtl.visual: Simple EN / ع toggle in topnav.

login_screen.layout: Split screen or Floating glass card on a high-end abstract enterprise background. JWT Auth forms with Role Selection dropdown for demo purposes.
login_screen.styling: Card uses heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) if over image, or crisp white if split screen. 1px border. No generic gradients.

dashboard.composition: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6).
dashboard.kpi_cards: col-span-1. Minimalist. Label in uppercase tracking-wider, large metric, small sparkline (Recharts) or trend indicator. 1px border, shadow-sm on hover.
dashboard.charts: Recharts. Use structural axes (stroke-opacity 0.2). Chart colors must pull from CSS variables (e.g., var(--primary), var(--accent)). Include Enrolment, At-risk, AI Sessions.

wizard_step_layout.ux: Multi-step form for Institution Setup. Vertical stepper on the left (col-span-1), form content on the right (col-span-3).
wizard_step_layout.visual: Active step highlighted with primary color. Completed steps have a check icon (Lucide). Shadcn Form components used strictly.

tree_builder.visual_language: Campuses -> Schools -> Departments -> Programmes -> Courses -> Modules -> Cohorts. Left-aligned indented list or bento-style nested cards. Use vertical connecting lines (border-l) to show hierarchy. Hover state reveals quick-actions (Add child, edit, delete).

role_management.ui: Dense data table (Shadcn Table). 15 roles. Columns: Role Name, Tenant Scope, Permissions count, Last Modified, Actions. Use badge pills for scopes.

trust_signals_and_compliance.ai_governance_badge: Top bar indicator. Green dot (pulse) + 'AI: Compliant' or 'Policy: Active'. Standardized badge variant.
trust_signals_and_compliance.audit_trails: Subtle text below major actions 'Last synced by System Admin 2 mins ago'. Uses small text (text-xs text-muted-foreground).

micro_animations.page_transitions: initial={opacity: 0, y: 10} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
micro_animations.list_stagger: staggerChildren: 0.05 for sidebar items and dashboard cards.
micro_animations.hover_states: -translate-y-[2px] shadow-md transition-all duration-200 for KPI cards.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
